status: User requirement recorded; revised proposal, no implementation approval
requirement: Frequent assignment must be directly discoverable from each Videos project row, with the minimum meaningful steps and no need to hunt through details or enable columns.

sourceEvidence.defaultTeamColumn: Hidden by default; optional Team cell opens the Team panel rather than a role picker.
sourceEvidence.projectQuickActions: Current project-name quick actions include Chat, Files where available, and Client portal; no direct labelled assignment action.

assessment: The previous editor-focused proposal did not fully address the entry path.
proposedEntry: Always-visible Assign team action in the leading project identity area. Available in normal desktop row layout, without hover, overflow menu, horizontal scrolling or column configuration. Preserve Staff-only management rights.
proposedQuickFlow: Open assignment directly from Videos. Show role and required hours at the top; show person choices with Staff capacity or Freelancer hourly rate/project cost. Review hours/cost and choose person before the distinct Assign or Invite action. Search is optional.

clickTarget.knownRole: Open chooser > choose person > Assign:3 clicks.
clickTarget.roleNeeded: Open chooser > choose role > choose person > Assign:4 clicks.
clickTarget.limit: 3/4-click targets apply only when role and prefilled required hours are already correct. Editing required hours is a necessary additional interaction, and must not be removed to meet a click count. Preserve Freelancer rate/terms and pending-invitation safeguards.

detailedManagement: Retain full Team management for invitation history, withdrawal and broader role settings. Required hours is part of quick assignment, not confined to detailed management.
preserve: Person selection is still distinct from assignment; invitations remain distinct from direct assignment. No new Undo or autosave behaviour is implied.
notApproved: Control placement, compact chooser composition and role-selection defaults remain proposals requiring agreement.

requiredHours.priority: Essential part of quick assignment, explicitly requested by Tom.
requiredHours.placement: Visible and editable alongside the role at the top of the quick chooser, before Assign or Invite. Do not move it behind detailed management.
requiredHours.initialValue: Prefill existing role hours when available; allow review/edit without unnecessary retyping. Preserve current hours rules.
requiredHours.cost: Show the Freelancer hourly rate and calculated project cost together. Hours changes update the calculated estimate. Preserve and clearly identify existing custom/agreed project-rate overrides; never silently replace them.
requiredHours.source: RoleEditorModal.tsx:getProjectRateValue uses hourly rate times role hours unless a project-rate override exists.

preservePreferredSummary: Preserve the first screenshot’s compact Videos Team summary and current function: avatars, role labels, invited treatment and +more count. Do not replace it with an assignment-only control.
